_doc: 80/20 1515: a 1.50 x 1.50 in (38.1 x 38.1 mm) T-slot profile of the 15 series, four open T-slots, clear anodised. Every value is in mm, with the inch figure it came from in its rule. Dimensions and section figures are from 80/20's Product Catalog 24. The drawn outline leaves out the rounds where the webs meet the core, the rounded tips of the lips and the small "align-a-grooves" on the faces.
